podcast.body: Featured on the *Demon Days* album, this song is highlighted for its elegant and less evident political content, contributing more depth than typical overt political messages. It avoided the classic, more obvious political commentary that was later criticized in the band's work. "el demon de Isk tenía canciones como Keats Weithance que yo creo que tenía un contenido político mucho más elegante y mucho menos evidente, que aportaba mucho más, porque no era el clásico contenido político."

One of four singles from the "Demon Days" album, featuring singer Neneh Cherry. It was part of a collaboration project stemming from the "Search for a Star" talent contest, where three winners contributed animation, remixes, or artwork. "Gorillas with Kids with Guns featuring singer Nina Cherry, and that's one of the four singles from the Demon Days album."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
